title: Three Nights and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：journey　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 journey 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the conductor ① started the journey that no stranger in the carriage would have recorded, and he said the starting was the whole of the night. The ② journey, meaning the trip itself and not the ticket, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; a journey, he said, is the only thing in a carriage that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ journey in that carriage had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ journey at the far window, meaning the stop they kept for the children to name and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A journey, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the conductor said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the journey was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the trip. The ⑥ journey, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; journey, he said, is either something you start or the only word that means both a trip and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ journey had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ journey of the whole thing, the conductor wrote in September, was one carriage and three nights of recording; journey, he said, is either the stop at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ journey I remember is the trip recorded in the log, which closed in 1991 and is still recorded as the quietest in the carriage. A ⑩ journey, my mother said in 1993, is the only trip that improves by being recorded; every journey, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a trip. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 旅程；行程（指车厢里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 旅程；行程（指那段行程本身，与车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：start the journey 启程这段旅程
D. n. 旅程；行程（指留给孩子们报出的一站那一段）
E. n. 旅途之事（抽象总称，指一处车厢的旅程之事）
F. n. 旅程；行程（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一段）
G. n. 变化、见闻（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 见闻（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: started the journey that no stranger in the carriage would have recorded
The journey, meaning the trip itself and not the ticket
the journey at the far window
the journey was the whole of the matter
the journey had become a line in a log
The journey of the whole thing
A journey, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: start the journey 意为“启程这段旅程”，1984 年那位列车员把车厢里没有一位陌生人肯记录的一段旅程做了一遍。
journey 意为“旅程；行程”，指那段行程本身而不是车票，它经过了三个夜而在簿子上没有被记录。
journey 意为“旅程；行程”，指车厢里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
journey 意为“旅程；行程”，指最远那扇车窗留给孩子们报出的一站那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
journey 意为“变化、见闻”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种变化就是那件事的全部。
journey 意为“见闻”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段行程，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
journey 意为“旅程；行程”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一段，到 1989 年这一段成了记录里的一行。
journey 意为“旅途之事”，列车员九月写道，整件事的旅程之事是一处车厢和三个夜的记录。
journey 意为“旅程；行程”，我记得的是记录里记录过的那一段，1991 年抵达了，至今仍被说成车厢里最安静的一段。
journey 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，旅程是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的行程。
